description.value:
You enhance your next round of ammunition with the might of the elements, empowering the next round in the chamber. When you cast this spell, choose an elemental trait and corresponding type of damage: electricity or sonic for air, bludgeoning or piercing for earth, acid or slashing for metal, fire for fire, bludgeoning or cold for water, or piercing or poison for wood. The next Strike you make with the wielded weapon before the end of your next turn gains the chosen elemental trait, damage trait, and deals an additional 1d6 damage of the chosen type of damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Infuse Ammo]

Heightened (6th) The additional damage increases to 2d6.
